newsitem.title: USA: REMEC Inc to acquire C&S Hybrid.
newsitem.headline: REMEC Inc to acquire C&S Hybrid.

text.p: REMEC Inc on Friday said it has reached a definitive agreement to merge, for its common stock, with C&S Hybrid, a privately held designer and maker of microwave components and multi-function modules, or MFMs, for the wireless communications market.
C&S Hybrid shareholders are expected to get about 860,000 shares of REMEC common stock, REMEC said in a statement.
In its first quarter ended March 31, C&S Hybrid generated about $4.6 million in sales and $270,000 in net income, up from $2.7 million and $167,000, respectively, one year earlier.

"The combination of C&S Hybrid and REMEC technology skills and business base is a major event in REMEC's acquisition strategy to consolidate superior industry capabilities," said Ronald Ragland, chief executive officer.
Tao Chow, chief executive at C&S Hybrid, will continue as president of the company, which will operate as a subsidiary of REMEC. Also, he will become a senior vice president of REMEC.
